_comment: Pinned program for 'Does #7 score the first goal?' on the best-goal clip. Same detect->crop->read_text->filter->temporal_order->answer shape as the hero, but filters on a NON-hero value (text == '7'). The clip's pinned scorer reads '7' and the goal event names them, so the subject is DERIVED as #7 (never a literal) and grounds to Yes. Window 11000-13000ms @ 8fps samples ts present in best-goal_cache.json's detect keys (incl. 12125, where p_seven is read) and stays inside duration_ms (30087). Validates against ../schema/dsl.schema.json.
